name: Text to PDF
description: Convert text into clean, downloadable PDFs instantly. Offline, private, powerful.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none';
